test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the bold part of the sentence.

We **enjoyed during the party** last night.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence "We enjoyed during the party last night" is grammatically incorrect because the verb "enjoyed" needs a reflexive pronoun like "ourselves" to indicate who is enjoying.
 
• The phrase "enjoyed ourselves" is standard English usage when expressing personal enjoyment.
 
• The preposition "at" is the correct choice to refer to the location of the party.
 
• Other options are either ungrammatical or do not fit the context of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct sentence is: ***"We enjoyed ourselves at the party last night."***

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"have enjoyed in party" – Incorrect because "have enjoyed" suggests present perfect tense, which does not match the past time mentioned ("last night"). Additionally, "in party" is incorrect; "at the party" is the proper phrase.
 
• **Option 3: **"had enjoyment during party" – Incorrect because "had enjoyment" is unnatural phrasing, and "during party" lacks the article "the" before "party."
 
• **Option 4: **"enjoyed in the party" – Incorrect because "enjoyed" needs a reflexive pronoun like "ourselves" when referring to personal enjoyment.
